acceptance.denominator: 2 fires over 2 Eastern days with bronze (2026-10-14, 2026-10-15); 10 coverage objects after 2 fires (8 touched days on fire 1, 2 on fire 2); planted gap on 2026-10-14 checked on fire 1 and after fire 2; derive_silver calls checked as a set of 2 days; 0 refused

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: MD2-x2-AC2 -- a two-day window splits its listed and fetched counts by each blob's own day; the cursor trims by age; the id-only actor counter reads 1 on a planted GUID-only event.
acceptance.denominator: 3 synthetic blobs over 2 Eastern days (2026-10-14: listed 2 fetched 1 gap True; 2026-10-15: listed 1 fetched 1 gap False); cursor of 3 seen entries trimmed to 2 (1 aged out); 3 planted events (1 GUID-only counted, 1 outsider dropped, 1 member kept); 4 assertion groups; 0 refused

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: MD2-x2-AC3 -- the keys equal builder output; the client invokes the collector alias; collector.tf has no data source and grants invoke on the alias ARN with no S3 or KMS action.
acceptance.denominator: 3 key equalities against lib/opal_naming address() output (bronze, cursor, coverage); 1 Qualifier check on lambda_invoker; collector.tf: 0 data blocks, 1 aws_iam_policy collector block naming aws_lambda_alias.collector.arn, 0 s3: or kms: actions in it; 0 refused

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: MD2-x2-AC4 -- (the fourth mechanical criterion, with its reason in the amendment above) a fire stops at its time budget, saves what it did without advancing past the unprocessed, and the next fires finish the backlog with every blob fetched exactly once. Two invariants: every partial save passes the population filter and the C-FIELDS levers before the write (planted outsider, subject, internal and external recipients searched in all stored bytes); the cursor advances only past blobs whose writes landed (a failed bronze put leaves the cursor unwritten).
acceptance.denominator: 60 blobs over 3 Eastern days, 25-second budget at 1 second per fetch: fire 1 stopped with complete=False after 25 fetches (<= 26 allowed); 3 fires in all, the third complete; 60 fetches, each blob once; 3 planted values searched in every stored object of the 3 fires; 1 failed bronze put checked (no cursor written); coverage documents carry complete false then true; 0 refused
